body.name: ComponentHandle
body.construction: Construct \(\mathfrak H_n^{\mathrm{comp}}\) by combining a smooth squared partition of unity at a fine scale with a smooth one-sided localization window, shared Rademacher coefficients, and joint \((A,Y)\)-cell perturbations that cancel after one sign average; condition on \(X_{1:n}\), connect observations whose active frames share a coefficient, factor the mixture over connected components, control each non-singleton component through a mixed amplitude derivative, and sum connected subsets by labeled spanning trees.
